## The readiness checklist, with a small figure above it.

<svg viewBox="0 0 400 40" width="40" height="4"><text x="0" y="30" font-size="8">trend</text></svg>

- Scoring policy signed by the council chair, with the policy hash recorded in the register
- Backtest delta published against the shipped scores for the last two full quarters
- Runbook updated with the new weights, the rollback path, and the owner on point for each
- On-call briefed, with the policy hash in the incident template and the escalation ladder
- Customer-facing changelog drafted and reviewed by support, legal, and the account team
- Regional residency review closed with no open findings and the evidence pack archived
- Data-retention job re-pointed at the new signal store and verified on a dry run
- Dashboard queries updated for the renamed score column across all six saved views
- Alert thresholds re-derived from the backtest rather than carried over unchanged
- Partner API contract re-checked against the new score range and its rounding rule
- Model card updated with the new weights and the date the council signed them off
- Post-launch review scheduled for six weeks out, with the observation window agreed
